name: webtop
title: Webtop
description: A full Linux desktop (Alpine XFCE by default) in a browser tab, from LinuxServer. Handy as a jump box on your LAN or for running a GUI tool on the server; the home directory persists in App-Data/Webtop/config. Set a password here or put it behind Authelia.

variables.name: WEBTOP_USER
variables.label: Login username
variables.description: Optional HTTP login for the desktop

policy_needs.reason: the browsers in the Webtop desktop sandbox themselves with system calls Docker's default profile blocks
